title: Impact of crystal structure on the thermoelectric properties of n-type SrTiO3
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00105F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alveena Z. Khan, Joseph M. Flitcroft, Jonathan M. Skelton
Ab initio modelling is used to explore the impact of crystal structure on the thermoelectric performance of SrTiO3 and highlights a balance between the electrical and thermal transport that is optimised in the hypothetical orthorhombic Pnma phase.
